title: Security Management System (SMS)
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSEA.NAVSEA WARFARE CENTER.NSWC PHILADELPHIA DIV
detail_text: The Naval Surface Warfare Center Philadelphia Dvision intends to procure onsite custom system modifications to the Lenel Security Management System (SMS) on a sole source to M3T Corporation. The proposed contract actions is for parts for which the Government intends to solicit and award to only one source under the authority of Far 6.302 Any questions regarding this notice should be e-mailed to: joseph.w.aprile2.civ@us.navy.mil Phone Calls will NOT be accepted.
